bibliography.title: Entropy and Isokinetic Temperature in Fast Ion Transport

mechanism_relevant_findings: The temperature dependence of ionic conductivity in solids often follows the Arrhenius law.
Lattice vibrations provide the excitation energy for the ions to overcome the activation barrier.
The multi-excitation entropy model suggests that isokinetic temperature can be tuned by modulating the excitation phonon frequency.

numerical_findings.conditions: found from the intersection of Arrhenius plots at different activation energies

arrhenius_vtf_findings: The activation energy and prefactor are determined from the slope and intercept of the Arrhenius plot.
limitations: A comprehensive understanding of the fundamental mechanism of MNR in ion transport is lacking.

relevance_judgement.reason: The paper provides significant insights into the Arrhenius behavior and conductivity mechanisms.
